purpose: Confirm the frozen LGTS-f4-Alpha candidate on untouched official test partitions after validation-only method selection.
model_rationale: Residual, mobile inverted-residual and modern efficient convolutional families provide three structurally distinct confirmatory backbones. DenseNet121 remains a completed validation-only transfer extension and is not reopened in this resource-bounded confirmatory phase.

seed_generation.method: Python secrets.randbelow; sampled once without replacement from six-digit positive integers

training.evaluation_partition: official test, evaluated once after the fixed training budget
training.checkpoint_selection: none; final epoch under a fixed budget

analysis.confirmatory_block: dataset x model; each block score is the mean over the five locked seeds
analysis.omnibus: Friedman test across the five activations on nine dataset-model blocks
analysis.paired_tests: two-sided exact Wilcoxon signed-rank tests comparing LGTS-f4-Alpha with each comparator; Holm family-wise correction
analysis.noninferiority_rule: 95% bootstrap lower confidence bound of the paired block difference must exceed -0.01
analysis.descriptive_reporting: mean, sample SD, paired differences, wins/ties/losses, average rank and 95% confidence intervals
analysis.alpha_reporting: layer mean, layer SD, minimum, maximum and boundary fraction for every run

resume_policy: Completed conditions are skipped using run-level done.json. An interrupted condition has no epoch checkpoint and restarts from epoch 1.
claim_boundary: Superiority is claimed only when multiplicity-corrected inference supports it. Otherwise the study reports competitiveness or non-inferiority with explicit efficiency trade-offs.
